summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 9.0.0 added FortiOS 7.4.1, improved no_log and documentation (seq_num, member_path, integer mkeys, FortiToken MFA, GET/PUT sent as POST), and raised the required Ansible version to 2.14.
questions: Why does fortios send GET/PUT as POST, is there a fix?
What ansible-core does fortinet.fortios need in Ansible 9?
How do I set up FortiToken MFA with fortios?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 9.0.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- Adds **FortiOS 7.4.1**; required ansible-core raised to **2.14.0**.
- Better `no_log` handling in some modules.
- Docs improved for `seq_num` in `fortios_router_static`, `member_path`, integer mkeys; Q&A added on FortiToken MFA and on requests always being sent as POST.
